versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file for simpler project structure.
- Minor update to runtime/run.mjs (details not specified).
- No changes to features, workflows, or user-facing documentation.

- Updated runtime and CLI discovery scripts for improved reliability.
- Clarified runtime documentation in references/runtime.md.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to skill boundaries or workflow.

- Initial release of yaps-memory skill.
- Enables finding and saving notes in your Yaps memory vault, including access to past dictations.
- Requires Yaps version 2.3.124 or newer.
- Uses local Yaps CLI with strong boundaries: does not enroll agent clients or overwrite established access controls.
- Supports project-scoped search and edit operations with careful handling of updates and permissions.
- Strictly prohibits bulk ingestion, policy edits, and unauthorized vault access.
